text:
anya: Heads-up — new CVE-2026-XXXX in libpq just hit our base image scans. We need a coordinated rebuild window for all runtime images.
matt: thanks. severity? any active exploit seen in telemetry?
anya: SRE found exploit attempts but failed auth. Severity: high (remote code exec). No customer impact so far.
jamal: propose patch + rebase onto ubuntu-22.04-patch2026. We'll need cosign signing, KMS key rotation, and RBAC for signer.
carol: on RBAC: current signer role is broad. We should create a dedicated `image-signer` KMS role with least privilege. @ops-oncall FYI for rotation window.
ops-oncall: Ack. Available for a 2hr window tomorrow 09:00-11:00UTC. We need runbook and rollback plan.
anya: Runbook draft: 1) Patch base package, 2) build images in staging, 3) run vuln scan, 4) cosign sign with `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKey` 5) promote and notify.
matt: add step: push SBOM and attestations to GCS and update registry metadata. Also log to audit-log with `resource.type="container"` and `operation="image-sign"`.
jamal: RBAC ACLs: `roles/imageSigner` binding to `serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood.internal` only during signing. Post-signing revoke.
carol: for KMS rotation: create new key version, test signing with `gcloud kms keys versions create`, then `cosign sign --key gcpkms://...` in staging.
security-bot: automated note — IANA CVE cross-ref added: CVE-2026-XXXX. Link: https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2026-XXXX
anya: vulnerability triage notes: exploit requires exposed DB socket; ensure runtime sandboxing and no unix socket mounts in prod images.
matt: runtime hardening checklist tweak: drop CAP_NET_RAW, enable no_new_privs, add seccomp profile `profiles/restricted.json`.
jamal: build pipeline change: use ephemeral builders, clear build cache, and use reproducible bakes. Example command:
```
bazel build //images:runtime --config=cosign && cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/.../cryptoKey/cryptoKeyVersion
```
carol: alerting: add eval to monitoring: spike in failed auth attempts correlated with CVE attempts. Create dashboard tile.
ops-oncall: I can run the rotation steps during window. Need a checklist for rollback: revert to previous image digest and revoke new key version permissions.
anya: I'll post the runbook in the docs channel after we finalize. For now, please ack readiness.
jamal: ack from infra.
matt: ack from runtime.
carol: ack from sec.
ops-oncall: ack from oncall.
buildbot: CI triggered for `images/runtime` staging build #4521 :green_heart:
anya: thanks team. Follow-up: tag threads with `#rebuild-cve2026` and file a short postmortem if any customer impact.
